Bug_Explanation: The bug is demonstrated by calling System.exit(0) in the showBug() method. This is not recommended when running in an application server as it terminates the JVM, causing all other applications running on the same application server to stop.
Trigger_Explanation: The testShowBug method calls the showBug method from the WebApplication class, which contains the bug of calling System.exit(0). This causes the JVM to terminate, which is the expected behavior to trigger the bug. The test then fails because it should not reach the fail statement.
Bug_Trigger_Explanation: The test did not terminate the JVM as expected, which suggests that the System.exit(0) call in the WebApplication class did not actually terminate the JVM. This indicates that the bug was not triggered in this test run.
